# Jane Andrews

- **Age:** Sixteen years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P46](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0046)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as plain.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Jane is steady, sensible, conscientious, and composed, possessing unflappable nerves that keep her calm during stressful situations such as examinations. Though she can be pragmatic and practical—such as viewing teaching primarily as a means to earn an independent salary—she is also capable of being deeply emotional and sympathetic.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c33 P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended school under Mr. Phillips, where she often expressed eagerness for his departure, though she wept openly when he left. She later studied under Miss Stacy and joined her classmates in preparing for the Entrance examination to Queen's Academy. During her school days, she participated in class activities, such as rehearsing a dialogue titled 'A Morning Visit' with Diana Barry and Ruby Gillis. After successfully passing her Entrance exams, she attended Queen's Academy, taking up Second Class work and excelling in the domestic science course. Upon completing her studies at Queen's and obtaining her license, she accepted a position to teach at the Newbridge school.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P15](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0015), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
